newsitem.title: DUBAI: Saudi Ceramics Co in 33.3 percent capital increase.
newsitem.headline: Saudi Ceramics Co in 33.3 percent capital increase.

text.p: The Saudi Ceramics Company will raise its paid up capital by 50 million riyals ($13.3 million), a 33.3 percent increase which will be paid for in full from retained profits, a statement said on Saturday.

"The board of directors has recommended raising the capital to 200 million riyals by issuing 500,000 new shares to current shareholders at the nominal value of 100 riyals each," the statement, a copy of which was received by Reuters said.
"Shareholders will be issued one new share for each three shares held," the statement added.
It said the capital increase would be subject to approval by the Saudi ministry of trade and the company's general assembly.
The company's 1996 third quarter results showed retained profits of about 174 million riyals.
